name: Electric Lint Remover | Rechargeable Anti-Pilling Fabric Shaver for Clothes & Sweaters
description:
Revive your clothes and fabrics with the Rechargeable Electric Lint Remover, designed to remove lint, fuzz, pet hair, and pills effortlessly. Its 6-tooth cutter head and 360° trimming design ensure fast, precise, and fabric-safe results. Suitable for sweaters, coats, and blankets, it keeps fabrics looking smooth and new. With cordless USB charging and a removable lint container, it’s convenient, safe, and easy to clean.
Key Features:
 Swiftly removes lint, fuzz, fluff & pet hair
 Gentle on fabrics, prevents scratches
 Works on clothes like sweaters, coats & blankets
 Cordless & rechargeable with USB convenience
 Removable lint container for easy cleaning
How to Use:
 Charge device fully before use
 Place on fabric and glide gently
 Empty lint container after use
 Clean mesh cover regularly for best results
Material:
ABS Plastic, Stainless Steel Cutter Head
Safety Information:
 Keep away from water during use
 Ensure mesh cover is secured before operation
 Do not use on delicate embroidery or loose threads
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes:
 1 × Electric Lint Remover
